references.text: Moses warns that the Israelites will become few in number among the nations if they are disobedient, reflecting the threat of perishing among the peoples.
The Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and only a small remnant of you will remain among the nations where the Lord drives you.
Ezekiel prophesies that the land will devour its inhabitants, which corresponds to the enemy's land devouring the Israelites.
The psalmist describes how God threatened to scatter their descendants among the nations and spread them throughout the lands.
Jeremiah prophesies that the Lord will scatter the people among nations that neither they nor their fathers knew.
Ezekiel speaks of a land that devours people and makes its people childless, in the context of God's judgment.
Moses warns that the Lord will scatter them among all peoples from one end of the earth to the other.
